name: Dhunseri Tea & Industries Ltd
summary: Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited engages in the cultivation, manufacture, and sale of loose and packet tea in India and internationally. The company offers tea under the Lal Ghora, Kala Ghora, and Bahipookri brand names. It also produces and sells macadamia nuts. The company was formerly known as Dhunseri Services Limited and changed its name to Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited in February 2014. Dhunseri Tea & Industries Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is based in Kolkata, India.
